name: omp-vibe
description: Imitates oh-my-pi (omp) /vibe mode and /prewalk handoff: uses PreToolUse & PreInvocation hooks to disable direct edit/command tools on the main Director session while opening worker orchestration for persistent fast (flash) & good (pro) subagents, plus a one-shot planning-to-implementation prewalk gate on normal sessions.
suggestedPrompts: /vibe 帮我重构并优化当前项目，拆分为并行工作流交给 fast 和 good 子代理执行
/vibe 先派 fast 子代理排查所有报错并收集日志，再派 good 子代理设计修复方案
/vibe off 退出 Vibe 模式并恢复主会话常规工具
/prewalk 先强规划建好 todos，首改后自动转 fast 实现风格收尾
